purpose: Document official local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Leshan city records establish a municipal real-estate registry and cadastral-survey responsibilities. Its reported central-city jurisdiction excludes named peripheral areas; the WUP locator appears city-centre but exact register coverage at the point was not tested. Public city map/service searches found no parcel-vector endpoint or schema. Registry notices were reviewed only as evidence that an office operates; no people, addresses or property identifiers were copied.
registryAssessment: Official Leshan sources identify the city-level Real Estate Registration Center, its jurisdiction over registered real property in the central city, and responsibility for cadastral/right-of-use surveys, mapping review and registry-information inquiries. A city government notification describes unified registration roles across central city and district offices. No anonymous parcel geometry service was found.
